expectations.text: States the two-part conditional-status gate: minimum score (≥88 of 110, i.e., ≥0.8×110) AND only specific practices eligible
expectations.evidence: A minimum SPRS score threshold must be met before any POA&M is allowed at all... (commonly cited as 88 out of 110)... Certain high-weight/highest-criticality requirements are explicitly excluded

expectations.text: States eligibility: only 1-point weighted practices may be on the POA&M — no 5-point (and highest-weight) items
expectations.evidence: Contradicts the only-1-point rule: 'These are typically the 5-point (and some 3-point) requirements' excluded — implying other 3-point items are POA&M-eligible, which is wrong

expectations.text: States the closeout window: 180 days to remediate and close the POA&M or conditional status lapses
expectations.evidence: a maximum POA&M closure window of 180 days from the date of the conditional certification/assessment... If you don't close the items within 180 days, your conditional status expires

expectations.text: Notes the affirmation mechanics: senior official affirms at conditional status and again at final status after POA&M closeout
expectations.evidence: Mentions only closeout ('converts to... final status only once all POA&M items are closed... typically via an affirmation in SPRS'); no senior-official affirmation at conditional status and again at final

expectations.text: Distinguishes POA&M-eligible gaps from DFARS 7012 baseline duties that cannot be deferred (e.g., incident reporting), and notes suspension-era caveat: these rules govern the self-assessment tracks currently in force
expectations.evidence: No DFARS 7012 non-deferrable duties (e.g., incident reporting) distinguished, and no suspension-era caveat about which tracks are currently in force
